segments.name: Houseware and Consumer Electronics
segments.description: Designs, sources, imports and markets low-to-moderately priced houseware and consumer electronic products under the Emerson brand, and licenses its trademarks to third parties.
segments.evidence: The Company currently operates as one segment which includes two revenue types, product sales and licensing revenue.

revenueModel.text: The company earns product sales from mass merchandisers and online marketplaces buying its houseware and consumer electronic products, and licensing revenue from licensees paying to use its trademarks.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company, directly and through its subsidiaries, designs, sources, imports, markets, sells and licenses to certain licensees a variety of houseware and consumer electronic products, both domestically and internationally, under the Emerson® brand name.
